summary: Tioga County, PA lookout site: tree tower before 1913, wood tower dated 1915 or 1917 by the two sources, no longer standing, no site description found.

facts.design: Tree tower first, then a wood tower of 30 to 35 feet (Forest Lookouts)
facts.status_note: Register says the tower is no longer standing; no source describes the site today

events.note: Forest Lookouts: a 30-35 foot wood tower erected. The register dates the wooden replacement to 1917, so the two disagree.
Register: a wooden tower replaced the first tree tower; the wooden tower was still used circa 1917

evidence.supports: First tree tower built before 1913; replaced in 1917 by a wooden tower
evidence.quote: The first tree tower was built before 1913 and was replaced in 1917 by a wooden tower.

evidence.supports: Wooden tower still used circa 1917 and is no longer standing
evidence.quote: That tower was still used circa 1917 and is no longer standing.

evidence.supports: Wood tower of 30 to 35 feet erected in 1915

corrections.why: Forest Lookouts gives a 30-35 foot range, not one height; 10.7 m is only the top of that range

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts dates the wood tower to 1915; the register dates a wooden replacement of the tree tower to 1917. The story presents this as a disagreement and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, both lookout registers or lists, and they disagree on the date (1915 vs 1917). The register page says 'No coordinates are available', yet the brief records 41.57517, -77.41746; those coordinates do not come from either cited page, so check them before publishing. The 'US 137' and 'PA 361' labels in the register are registry numbers, not highway routes. Two searches turned up nothing further on this tower. No staffing, fire or access record was found, and no photo was found. The brief's height of 10.7 m is the top of a 30-35 foot range (see corrections).
